about: The 31 demo chunks (content/rag-assets/demos/corpus.js) and where each lives in this pack. lab_file + lab_match let the lab tag its own chunks with these ids for the golden set.

chunks.lab_match: Kick-off of the central log platform POC. Attendees: Sam, Priya, Lee. Candidates: vendor A, vendor B, vendor C. Scope: Content Hub server logs first.

chunks.lab_match: Known issue KI-014.
chunks.text: Known issue KI-014. Platform: Content Hub. Symptom: search returns nothing for one tenant. Cause: index job for that tenant's folder stalled. Check: index queue; index worker status. Fix: restart the index worker, re-queue the folder.

chunks.lab_match: Known issue KI-022.
chunks.text: Known issue KI-022. Platform: Content Hub. Symptom: alert mail, transfer timeout for one document ID. Cause: target busy during the night batch. Check: transfer.log and index.log for the ID. Fix: reprocess the ID after 06:00.

chunks.lab_match: Known issue KI-031.
chunks.text: Known issue KI-031. Platform: Legacy Archive. Symptom: web viewer fails to open documents, API works. Cause: web viewer session limit reached. Fix: recycle the viewer's app pool.

chunks.lab_match: Known issue KI-040.
chunks.text: Known issue KI-040. Platform: Content Hub. Symptom: file not found for a document that search lists. Cause: document moved during migration, index points to the old path. Fix: re-index the document.

chunks.lab_match: Known issue KI-047.
chunks.text: Known issue KI-047. Platform: Capture. Symptom: batch stuck at the remote site. Cause: export to target failed and was not retried. Fix: retry the export.

chunks.lab_match: Note to self: if re-queue does not help for a tenant, stop the index worker, clear its temp folder, then start it and re-queue. Worked for Fabrikam Legal in July.
chunks.text: Note to self: if re-queue does not help for a tenant, stop the index worker, clear its temp folder, then start it and re-queue. Worked for Fabrikam Legal in July.
